name: FireKey
description: Manage persistent browser profiles for AI agents and automation teams through a local MCP server and authenticated desktop API.

skills.name: Named Browser Profiles
skills.description: List, create, update, group, and delete named browser profiles through the local MCP control layer.

skills.name: Profile Lifecycle
skills.description: Start, inspect, and stop an authorized browser profile while keeping lifecycle state visible to the desktop operator.

skills.name: Local Automation Connection
skills.description: Return a loopback browser connection for an authorized profile so Playwright or Puppeteer can attach locally.

skills.name: Profile Groups
skills.description: Organize profiles into groups for repeatable team workflows without exposing cookies or connection secrets in model output.
